retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast yellow layout featuring heavy sans-serif headers and a dense vertical list balanced by a hand-drawn scribble portrait peeking from a torn white base.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant yellow field dominated by a massive, ultra-bold black title at the top right. A long, left-aligned list of text occupies the left half, while the bottom right features a high-contrast black and white scribble-style illustration of a face emerging from a jagged, torn-paper white footer.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive header scale vs. dense body text
Solid yellow field vs. textured scribble illustration
Clean geometric typography vs. organic torn paper edge
Asymmetrical balance between top-right weight and bottom-right imagery
coreInvariants: Torn paper horizontal divider at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Title is dominant at top right; tracklist is a vertical block on the left; portrait is medium-scale at bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The ultra-bold black title 'ISOLATION' acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title, drops to the tracklist, and ends on the textured face at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample yellow space around the title and between the list and the portrait to prevent clutter.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid Black for typography and illustration
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure White for the torn paper base and metadata
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow paired with maximum value contrast (black/white).

letterConstructionRules: Headers use ultra-expanded and ultra-bold weights
Body text uses uniform stroke widths with no serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single sans-serif family using extreme weight and width contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and clean geometry for the header.
Excellent legibility for the dense tracklist at small sizes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid bright yellow background. At the bottom, add a white horizontal section with a jagged, hand-torn paper top edge. In the bottom right, place a high-contrast black and white scribble-style illustration of a human face peeking over the torn edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ultra-bold black sans-serif title in the top right. Add a long, left-aligned numbered list of text in a medium-weight black sans-serif on the left side. Place a small boxed logo in the top left.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant yellow?
Is the bottom edge a white torn-paper effect?
Is the portrait rendered in a black ink scribble style?
Is the main header significantly larger and bolder than the list text?

adjustableVariables: Jaggedness of the torn paper edge
Number of items in the tracklist
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
The specific facial features of the illustration
postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between yellow and white
Ensure the scribble texture doesn't look like a photo filter
Verify the title is ultra-bold and expanded
Confirm the torn edge looks organic and non-repetitive
recipe.reuseFormula: Yellow field + Torn white base + Scribble art + Brutalist Sans-Serif Typography
